note: Major projects being built or planned in Ward 5 that the City's open data lists of facilities do not have yet. Each entry is checked against the owner's page or a news report (sources). When a project opens, the app marks it completed by itself once the City lists it: 'match' gives words of its name to look for in the City's recreation facilities and school lists, and a listed facility or school within 400 m of lat/lon also counts. 'expected_by' (YYYY-MM) flags a project that should have opened but is not listed yet. To mark one by hand, set "state": "completed" and "opened": "YYYY-MM".

projects.title: Northeast Athletic Complex
projects.budget: $170.4 million, fully funded (2026 budget, approved December 2025)
projects.address: Northwest corner of 80 Avenue NE and Metis Trail NE (34.6-acre site)
projects.what: Calgary's first competition-capable cricket field, four outdoor multi-use artificial turf fields, an indoor fieldhouse with an artificial turf field and indoor cricket batting nets, 16 team rooms, spectator seating, pathways, picnic areas and a playground, on a 35-acre site. More than 500 parking spaces. General contractor: Ledcor. Development permit approved by Calgary Planning Commission on April 30, 2026.

projects.title: Blue Line LRT extension to 88 Avenue NE
projects.status: Design (30% design due about end of 2026)
projects.budget: About $160 million (estimate). Design funded by the City and Alberta; Alberta announced $43.3M toward construction in 2024; the rest is not yet secured
projects.completion: Construction tentatively 2028 (2027 if other governments fund it sooner)
projects.address: Saddletowne Station to a new station at 88 Avenue NE and 60 Street NE (about 1 km)
projects.what: One new station serving Savanna and nearby communities, an interim end point for local bus routes and the starting point for a future airport connection. Extending on to Country Hills Boulevard (for Cityscape, Redstone and Cornerstone) is in the 10-year capital plan but unfunded. In the City's 2026 engagement nearly 90% of 724 respondents supported it; parking, safety and lighting were the main concerns.

projects.title: Lufthansa Technik engine maintenance facility (YYC AeroNex)

projects.what: About 150,000 sq. ft. engine repair shop with a test cell for Boeing 737 MAX engines; at least 160 permanent jobs by 2030 and 170 construction jobs. Part of the YYC AeroNex aviation hub.

projects.title: Saddle Ridge Crossing (condos, shops and offices)
projects.status: Phase one under construction (building permit for an office/retail building issued August 12, 2026)
projects.completion: 2026 to 2027 for phase one; more phases later
projects.what: Over 600 condos and about 200,000 sq. ft. of shops, restaurants, medical and other offices at full build-out. Phase one: 120 condos in two six-storey buildings and about 83,000 sq. ft. of commercial space.
